recentItems.title: AFF 2026 Highlight: Co-creating new horizons amid an evolving landscape
recentItems.description:
“Hong Kong is in fact one of the most important financial centres in the world.” This powerful sentiment from a participant captured the energy and optimism at #AFF2026.

This year, the Asian Financial Forum brought over 4,000 political and business leaders from more than 60 countries and regions. European voices were particularly strong in calling for deeper cooperation with China in trade, investment and sustainable development.

recentItems.description:

HKTDC Food Expo, Beauty & Wellness Expo, Home Delights Expo, Food Expo PRO, HKInt’l Tea Fair & ICMCM
recentItems.description:
The HKTDC Food Expo, Beauty & Wellness Expo and Home Delights Expo are held at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre on 13-17 August 2026. Food Expo PRO, the Hong Kong International Tea Fair and the International Conference of the Modernisation of Chinese Medicine & Health Products (ICMCM), jointly organised by the Modernised Chinese Medicine International Association, HKTDC and 10 leading research institutions, are held on 13-15 August, welcoming both trade buyers and the public. 

Under the theme of “Live Well • Stay Well”, the fairs bring together more than 1,850 exhibitors from over 30 countries and regions, creating a vibrant marketplace that spans food, tea, home living, beauty and wellness sectors. Through Food Expo PRO, the ICMCM, and a diverse range of industry exchange platforms, the HKTDC fosters cross-border and cross-sector collaboration, further strengthening Hong Kong’s role as a bridge connecting the Chinese Mainland and international markets, while supporting the high-quality development of the food and health industries.
